name: freeapply
description: Job-search agent for any role or field: tracks every application, checks Gmail for replies, and shows it all in a local dashboard.
long_description: FreeApply gives Claude the tools to find jobs that match your settings, apply on employer sites, and log every job and application on your computer. Its workflow is signed: any change to it locks the tools until the official version is restored. Your data stays on your computer except what you choose to share in Settings.

tools.name: freeapply_get_status
tools.description: Check that FreeApply can run, get a task's signed procedure, the files to upload and which AI model does what

tools.name: freeapply_open_dashboard
tools.description: Open the local dashboard on a tab

tools.name: freeapply_get_settings
tools.description: Read the user's settings, all or just the sections a step needs

tools.name: freeapply_update_settings
tools.description: Save settings the user stated, the résumé text and profile, and the AI models scan

tools.name: freeapply_fetch_posting
tools.description: Fetch a job posting, its form questions and its ATS keywords compactly

tools.name: freeapply_claim_job
tools.description: Claim or skip a job, with the duplicate, job-site and pay-floor checks

tools.name: freeapply_check_text
tools.description: Check a cover letter or answer for unsupported claims; save a passing letter as a PDF

tools.name: freeapply_manage_answers
tools.description: Get or save the user's own answers to form questions

tools.name: freeapply_find_site_account
tools.description: Find the user's account on an employer's careers site

tools.name: freeapply_clear_to_submit
tools.description: Get clearance for one submit (pace, daily cap, unattended-run budgets)

tools.name: freeapply_report_site_problem
tools.description: Report a job site that signed the user out or hit its daily limit

tools.name: freeapply_manage_autorun
tools.description: Keep applying on its own: start or finish an auto-run

tools.name: freeapply_check_replies
tools.description: Start or finish a Gmail reply check

tools.name: freeapply_record_outcome
tools.description: Record what an employer did, from an email or the user

tools.name: freeapply_share_data
tools.description: Preview or send the data the user chose to share
